title: Cocket
summary: COCKET, adjective Brisk; pert. COCKET, noun A seal of the custom-house; a royal seal; rather a scroll of parchment, sealed and delivered by the officers of the customhouse, to merchants, as a warrant

inlines.v: COCKET, adjective Brisk; pert. COCKET, noun A seal of the custom-house; a royal seal; rather a scroll of parchment, sealed and delivered by the officers of the customhouse, to merchants, as a warrant that their merchandize is entered. The office of entry.
